_note: Every field is OPTIONAL except `file`; the scorer only grades the fields you provide. `total` = amount PAID (after discounts). `vat_rate` = the dominant printed rate. `_note` is ignored by the scorer.
`vendor_alt` lists other acceptable vendor names (e.g. platform vs merchant). Omit `vat_amount`/`vat_rate` when the receipt prints no VAT table.
